faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find quick answers to common questions about our services.

q1.question: How long does a typical wash service take?
q1.answer: Our standard wash takes about 30 minutes, while premium services like nano ceramic coating can take 2-3 hours.

q2.question: Do I need to book an appointment?
q2.answer: Walk-ins are welcome, but we recommend booking an appointment to guarantee your preferred time slot.

q3.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q3.answer: We accept cash, all major credit cards, and mobile payment options like Apple Pay and Google Pay.

q4.question: Is BLINK a mobile service?
q4.answer: Yes! We are a fully mobile service. We bring everything needed to your location.

hero.title: Our Premium Services
hero.subtitle: Professional car care tailored to your needs

wash.title: Wash
wash.description: Complete exterior and interior cleaning service using premium products and professional techniques. Includes hand wash, interior vacuuming, dashboard cleaning, and tire shine.
wash.features: Thorough wash, Interior cleaning, Dashboard care, Tire shine

premium.title: Classic
premium.desc: Quick cleaning - light polish - refreshed look
points: • Thorough exterior wash with water or steam.
• Removal of surface dust and dirt.
• Wheel polishing.
• Wiping the car’s inside.
• Vacuuming the car’s floor.
• 🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal.
The ideal option for daily routines and cars in excellent condition.

Blink.title: Premium
Blink.desc: Precise details - luxurious finish - superior shine
points: • Thorough cleaning inside and out with high precision.
• Special care for the bodywork,Engine room,chrome, and tires.
• Deep interior detailing.
• Removing deep stains and vacuuming the floors.
• Special care for the bodywork, chrome, and tires.
• Luxurious finish with deep shine and exceptional results.
• 🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover.
A distinctive service for lovers of detail and luxurious appearance.

dryclean.title: Dry Clean
dryclean.description: Specialized dry cleaning service for upholstery, carpets, and interior fabrics. Removes stains, odors, and restores the original look of your car's interior.
dryclean.features: Upholstery cleaning, Stain removal, Odor elimination, Fabric protection

premium.title: Classic
premium.desc: Basic cleaning - instant refreshment - quick care
points: • Surface cleaning of seats and carpets.
• Dusting of dashboard and doors.
• Refreshing scent for the cabin.
• 🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover.
Suitable for cars that need a simple interior refresh without deep detailing.

Blink.title: Premium
Blink.desc: Attention to detail - thorough cleaning - a luxurious interior experience
points: • Thorough interior cleaning with attention to detail.
• Removal of tough stains and grease from seats and surfaces.
• Sterilization and softening of leather and fabric materials.
• Finished with a special fragrance and a luxurious touch from GroupSide.
• 🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover.
Designed for cars that deserve the highest level of care and interior renewal.

polish.title: Paint Polish & Correction
polish.description: Professional paint correction and polishing service that removes scratches, swirl marks, and oxidation to restore your car's original shine and luster.
polish.features: Scratch removal, Swirl mark correction, Paint restoration, Mirror finish

one_stage.title: Stage 1
points: Light treatment in one step.
Restores shine and improves the appearance of the bodywork.
Suitable for new cars or cars in excellent condition.
🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover

two_stage.title: Stage 2
points: Stage 1: Correcting scratches and moderate imperfections.
Stage 2: Final polishing and intense shine.
Perfect balance between time and results.

three_stage.title: Stage 3
points: Stage 1: Deep correction of scratches.
Stage 2: Medium polishing to refine the bodywork.
Stage 3: Final polishing with a luxurious glass shine.
Designed for professional results and distinctive cars.
🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover

Conclusion.title: Conclusion
Conclusion.description: In short, the more stages of polishing, the more accurate and stronger the result, but at the same time, it requires more time and experience. Choosing the right stage depends on the condition of the car and the result you want to achieve.

nano.title: Nano Ceramic Coating
nano.description: Advanced nano ceramic coating technology that creates a protective layer on your vehicle's paint. Provides excellent hydrophobic properties, UV protection, and chemical resistance.
nano.features: Hydrophobic coating, UV protection, Chemical resistance, Enhanced gloss
points: • Transparent protective layer covering the body.
• Protects against sunlight, dust, and minor scratches.
• Makes washing easier and maintains shine for a long time.
• 🎁 Dry cleane.
• 🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover.
Deep shine and continuous daily protection.

graphene.title: Graphene Coating
graphene.description: Revolutionary graphene coating technology offering superior protection and performance. Provides exceptional durability, heat dissipation, and anti-static properties.
graphene.features: Superior durability, Heat dissipation, Anti-static properties, Self-healing technology
points: • Advanced protective layer containing graphene.
• Higher resistance to water and heat.
• Provides a deeper shine that lasts longer than nano-ceramic.
• 🎁 Dry cleane.
• 🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover.
Advanced technology... Luxury protection that lasts longer.
